classes.label: free protein only
classes.meaning: room only on the unassembled protein: before assembly, or after release

classes.label: precursor only
classes.meaning: room on an assembly intermediate, none on the mature ribosome: during assembly

classes.label: free subunit only
classes.meaning: room only without the other subunit: before joining, or after splitting

classes.label: translation state
classes.meaning: room on the vacant and the translating ribosome differs: a translation-state dependent site

classes.label: mature only
classes.meaning: room on the mature ribosome, none on the precursor (an assembly factor or the immature particle takes it): after assembly

classes.label: throughout
classes.meaning: room at every stage the protein is part of: the window says nothing about the stage

classes.label: none found
classes.meaning: no room at any stage, not even on the free protein: a conformation the structures do not show

classes.label: flexible segment
classes.meaning: not modelled in any particle: a mobile segment, or a protein the structures do not resolve; reachable at any stage as far as they say
